metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2026 · Hope
metas.description: A mysterious discovery is made on the outskirts of the remote harbor town. The residents find themselves in a desperate fight for survival against something they have never encountered before.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2020 · #Alive
metas.description: The rapid spread of an unknown infection has left an entire city in ungovernable chaos, but one survivor remains alive in isolation. It is his story.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2016 · Seoul Station
metas.description: Several groups of people try to survive a zombie pandemic that unleashes itself in downtown Seoul.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2004 · R-Point
metas.description: During the Vietnam War, a South Korean base receives a radio transmission from a missing squad, presumed dead, and sends a platoon to rescue the lost squad from the R-Point.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 1986 · Aliens
metas.description: Decades after surviving the Nostromo incident, Ellen Ripley is sent out to re-establish contact with a terraforming colony but finds herself battling the Alien Queen and her offspring.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2013 · World War Z
metas.description: Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane traverses the world in a race against time to stop a zombie pandemic that is toppling armies and governments and threatens to destroy humanity itself.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2009 · Zombieland
metas.description: A shy student trying to reach his family in Ohio, a gun-toting bruiser in search of the last Twinkie and a pair of sisters striving to get to an amusement park join forces in a trek across a zombie-filled America.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1987 · Predator
metas.description: A team of commandos on a mission in a Central American jungle find themselves hunted by an extraterrestrial warrior.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2008 · Cloverfield
metas.description: A group of friends venture deep into the streets of New York on a rescue mission during a rampaging monster attack.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2005 · Constantine
metas.description: Detective Angela approaches Constantine, a demon hunter, to help her investigate her twin sister's mysterious death. As he digs deeper, he realizes that demons are trying to enter the human world.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1996 · From Dusk Till Dawn
metas.description: Two criminals and their hostages unknowingly seek temporary refuge in a truck stop populated by vampires, with chaotic results.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 1992 · Alien³
metas.description: Returning from LV-426, Ellen Ripley crash-lands on the maximum-security prison Fiorina 161, where she discovers that she has unwittingly brought along an unwelcome visitor.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1998 · Blade
metas.description: A half-vampire, half-mortal man becomes a protector of the mortal race, while slaying evil vampires.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2002 · Resident Evil
metas.description: A special military unit fights a powerful, out-of-control supercomputer and hundreds of scientists who have mutated into flesh-eating creatures after a laboratory accident.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2016 · Train to Busan
metas.description: While a zombie virus breaks out in South Korea, passengers struggle to survive on the train from Seoul to Busan.
